findings.book_entry: An earthly kingdom, city, state, or governed political body riding upon the sea of peoples: its rulers guide it, its inhabitants and servants crew it, its armies defend it, and its wealth is carried as cargo. Christ needs no constructed body beneath Him: He walks upon the sea directly, and when He sails with His disciples the vessel comes under its true Head. The ship may be broken while its people survive.

openai.adjudicated_core_identification: A ship can signify a bounded, organized, governed political or civic body, with its leaders as pilots, its people as crew, its defenders aboard, and its wealth as cargo.

anthropic.adjudicated_core_identification: A ship is an earthly kingdom, city, state, or governed political body riding upon the sea of peoples: its pilots are its rulers, its crew its inhabitants and servants, its defenders its armies, and its cargo its wealth; the ship may be broken while its people survive.
